response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: Rows with proccpu = 0 are treated as having a missing GPU/CPU ratio (NULLIF) so they are ignored in the ratio average instead of causing a division error. Their memusagegb still counts toward the RAM average.
The ratio is computed per run as procgpu/proccpu using non-integer division, and those ratios are then averaged per site. It is not the ratio of the averages.
A site with a NULL entrystat would form its own group in the output. Matching a site is done with an inner join on zoneref = zoneregistry.
